notes: Three isnads for one saying, each ending at al-Rida; the lineage «حدثني أبي موسى بن جعفر ... عن علي بن أبي طالب» is written once after them: the shared tail
Each «أبي» + name is one link (rule 7); the Companion «علي بن أبي طالب» reports the Prophet's words
Dates, places and blessings are left out; surfaces kept as the text writes them (joined words such as «عبدالله» are not split)
